description: Returns all information associated with the account of provided Pubkey.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: The Pubkey of the account to query encoded as base-58 string

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: The configuration object with the following fields:

sub_parameters.name: commitment
sub_parameters.description: The level of commitment required for the query. The options include:

sub_parameters.name: finalized
sub_parameters.description: The node will query the most recent block confirmed by the supermajority of the cluster as having reached maximum lockout, meaning the cluster has recognized this block as finalized

sub_parameters.name: confirmed
sub_parameters.description: The node will query the most recent block that has been voted on by the supermajority of the cluster

sub_parameters.name: processed
sub_parameters.description: The node will query its most recent block. Note that the block may not be complete

sub_parameters.name: encoding
sub_parameters.description: (Default: binary) The encoding format for account data. It can be one of base58 (slow), base64, binary, base64+zstd or jsonParsed

sub_parameters.name: dataSlice
sub_parameters.description: The returned account data using the provided offset: 'usize' and length: 'usize' fields; only available for base58, base64, or base64+zstd encodings

sub_parameters.name: minContextSlot
sub_parameters.description: The minimum slot at which the request can be evaluated

result.description: Null if the account doesn't exist otherwise RpcResponse JSON object with the following fields:

result.context.description: An object that contains metadata about the current state of the Solana network at the time the request was processed

result.context.slot.description: The current slot in the Solana cluster during which the transactions are processed and new blocks are added to the blockchain

result.value.description: An object that contains information about the requested account

result.value.lamports.description: The number of lamports assigned to this account as u64 (64-bit unsigned integer)

result.value.owner.description: The base-58 encoded Pubkey of the program this account has been assigned to

result.value.data.description: Data associated with the account. Format depends on encoding parameter:

result.value.executable.description: A boolean indicating if the account contains a program (and is strictly read-only)

result.value.rentEpoch.description: The epoch at which this account will next owe rent, as u64 (64-bit unsigned integer)

result.value.space.description: The amount of storage space required to store the token account
